brief: Multimodal biometric emotion scanner combining WebGL neural face mesh tracking and vocal prosody analysis for real-time affective computing.

concepts.name: Neural Iris
concepts.idea: Concentric biometric aperture and focal node: multimodal sensory convergence.
rationale: Aperture lines evoke real-time optical scanning and iris tracking.
Emerald focal point represents the user's emotional core and neural response.
Perfect 1:1 geometry ensures 100% legibility from 16px favicons to billboard displays.

recommendation: The Neural Iris mark provides an ownable, high-tech identity that represents both the visual face-mesh tracking and the voice prosody sensor fusion.
